description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.

> This parameter is available only in hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query Hybrid Cloud WAF clusters.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
检测统计类型。取值：
- **risk**：表示风险影响统计。
- **event**：表示攻击影响统计。
description.en:
The type of detection statistics. Valid values:

- **risk**: statistics on security risks.

- **event**: statistics on attacks.
The list of statuses used to filter the detection statistics.

title.zh: 查询API安全检测统计信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-statistics --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-uax000b09 --type risk --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek2000uwbs5q --start-time 1668496310 --end-time 1726113600 --user-status-list toBeConfirmed --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
